Transit: TransLink route 601 runs Boundary Bay trips via 12 Avenue, Boundary Bay Road, 3 Avenue and 67 Street to 1A Avenue, continuing via South Delta Exchange and Ladner Exchange to Bridgeport Station (Canada Line).

Health care: Delta Hospital, 5800 Mountain View Blvd, in Ladner, is the nearest hospital, and Fraser Health lists a South Delta After-Hours Urgent and Primary Care Centre serving Tsawwassen at 1826 – 4949 Canoe Pass Way.

items.t: The hazard permit area is named for this ground. SD3 is literally titled "Boundary Bay Foreshore and the Southlands" in OCP Appendix B — the 2.9 m / 2.3 m / 7.5 m figures are not generic Delta rules applied here; they were written for this shoreline and this development area.

"Flats" is the developer's word for condos at Southlands. Century Group calls its apartment product "flats" (garden flats, country flats) — a buyer searching only "condos" misses District Flats, High Street Flats and The Granary's flat component in developer and presale records.

The Granary's courtyard neighbour is a brewery. The Four Winds brewery and gastropub encloses the north end of The Granary's garden courtyard — an amenity and a noise/activity fact in the same structure, worth a site visit at pub hours before writing on a courtyard-facing flat.

Most of Centennial Beach is closed to dogs. Metro Vancouver states most of the beach is dog-prohibited, with signed marker posts showing where — a daily-life fact for dog owners that listing copy for "steps to the beach" homes does not mention.
The feed's edge is not the neighbourhood's edge.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Boundary Beach
Fee-simple lots

items.t: Fee-simple is the default tenure here: no strata corporation, no Form B, no strata fees on a fee-simple lot.
Subdivision potential runs off the parcel's own zone; zoning is parcel by parcel on the City zoning maps.

blocks.text: Bare-land strata as its own form

items.t: A bare-land strata lot IS strata tenure: the buyer owns the strata lot (essentially the building lot itself) and the house on it, and Form B, strata fees for common property, and registered bylaws apply to the lot. It is NOT a fee-simple lot. Monterra is freehold strata of the conventional (non-bare-land) plan form per its data sheet.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Boundary Beach

items.t: Subdivision / servicing — process documented, number not asserted: 506, confirmed with the City for the specific parcel — instead of asserting the number as governing.

Dyke / flood frame: the shore sits behind the Boundary Bay dike; Delta is the diking authority (over 63 km of flood protection infrastructure, 31 drainage pump stations, ~538 km of drainage infrastructure). Foreshore tenure: the Province owns nearly all saltwater foreshore; tenure is by lease or licence only via FrontCounter BC, and private moorage is held under General Permission or Specific Permission — a "private dock" is not land the seller owns.

ALR block (farm-edge parcels, where ALR ground is met): ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; Strata Property Act s. 239; ALCA s. 21(1)); subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval. Residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha). Farm class — three-tier, in full: $2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; applications by October 31. A flat "$2,500+" statement is an ERROR.

Bare-land strata / strata block (applies to any strata lot here, Monterra included): Form B (SPA s. 59) discloses monthly fees, amounts owed, approved levies still payable, CRF balance and insurance summary, with rules, budget and most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, max $35 + 25¢/page. Depreciation reports every 5 years for strata corporations with 5+ lots since July 1, 2024, non-deferrable. CRF minimum contribution 10% of the operating budget since November 1, 2023. Rental-restriction bylaws VOID since November 24, 2022 (long-term; short-term may still be restricted) — Monterra's data-sheet "Rentals Not Allowed" line is VOID for long-term rentals. Only 55+ age bylaws are valid (SPA ss. 123.1/123.2 + Regulation 7.01, incl. the May 1, 2023 exemptions); a "45+" listing line is NOT a valid BC age bylaw, and Monterra's "Adult Oriented" site-influence line is not an age bylaw — no 55+ bylaw is verified for Monterra. Fee-simple contrast: a fee-simple lot carries none of this.

Speculation / vacancy + prohibition: SVT taxable areas include the City of Delta; reserve/treaty/self-governing lands are excluded; the Vancouver Empty Homes Tax (3%) is Vancouver ONLY. SVT payable on a specific parcel: Not confirmed.

blocks.text: Boundary Beach: the housing stock

items.t: Waterfront homes here sit behind engineered seawalls on private property, not a public promenade, which is why two houses on the same street can have very different flood works.

blocks.text: Boundary Beach: rules that affect buyers

items.t: The Boundary Bay Foreshore and the Southlands (SD3) Development Permit Area is the controlling rule: the City's seawall form requires a crest elevation of 4.1 metres Geodetic Survey of Canada (GSC) datum, designed so it can be raised a further 1.4 metres, with a wave deflector and erosion protection at the toe.
A new seawall needs an engineered design by a structural engineer, and an existing seawall needs an engineer's certification of its structural and flood-protection integrity.

blocks.text: Boundary Beach: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Most of Centennial Beach is closed to dogs, with signed marker posts showing where dogs are prohibited — relevant if you are buying for daily dog walks.
The park is an internationally recognized Important Bird Area and a Pacific Flyway stop, so seasonal bird closures and crowds are part of beach life here.
Route 601 runs Boundary Bay trips via 12 Avenue, Boundary Bay Road, 3 Avenue and 67 Street, so the beach streets do have a bus, but it is the long way to Bridgeport Station.
The Dyke Trail runs through Boundary Bay Regional Park, so the dike top doubles as the neighbourhood's walking and cycling route, not just flood works.

blocks.text: Boundary Beach: getting around

items.t: Driving is the default here: Boundary Bay Road and 56 Street are the routes north to Highway 17 and the George Massey Tunnel corridor.
The British Columbia Ferries (BC Ferries) Tsawwassen terminal is reached by Highway 17, with sailings to Swartz Bay, Duke Point and the Southern Gulf Islands.

blocks.text: Boundary Beach: risks and due diligence

items.t: Seawall condition is the lot-specific risk: get the engineer's certification the City requires for existing seawalls, and price future raising, because the design standard assumes the crest may need to go 1.4 metres higher.

Sea-level rise is the long-term driver: the City states future sea levels are expected to rise and its dike must be raised to protect the community, which is why flood covenants and floor levels follow these lots on title.
